examples.scenario: Two DTM tiles overlap and input order changes between runs.
examples.reason: Classic VRT/mosaic overlap priority depends on ordered inputs.

examples.scenario: Lower-priority tile is valid but later tile has nodata at the seam.
examples.reason: Nodata may expose lower-priority data and must be explicit.

examples.scenario: A later source has alpha=0 and silently overwrites earlier terrain.
examples.reason: Classic VRT priority is not general alpha compositing.

examples.scenario: -ignore_srcmaskband is enabled in only one replay.
examples.reason: Source mask participation changes overlap values.

examples.scenario: Intrinsic nodata is replaced by an input override without manifesting it.
examples.reason: Validity semantics changed.

examples.scenario: Output nodata differs between primary and replay.
examples.reason: Uncovered and invalid output pixels can differ.

examples.scenario: Uncovered pixels inside mosaic extent remain zero with no nodata metadata.
examples.reason: Zero may be a valid elevation and cannot mark absence implicitly.

examples.scenario: Alpha band is added in only one mosaic build.
examples.reason: Coverage validity representation changed.

examples.scenario: One tile is 1 m and another 2 m but resolution policy is omitted.
examples.reason: Target grid is under-specified.

examples.scenario: highest resolution is replaced by average resolution.
examples.reason: Output grid and sample support change.

examples.scenario: common resolution is selected in one replay only.
examples.reason: Derived target pixel size changes.

examples.scenario: Target-aligned-pixels is toggled between runs.
examples.reason: Extent origin and pixel addresses may shift.

examples.scenario: Mosaic bbox is inferred in one run and explicit in another.
examples.reason: Target extent belongs in terminal provenance.

examples.scenario: Relative VRT source path resolves against a different directory.
examples.reason: A different physical source file may be opened.

examples.scenario: Absolute paths are introduced after a host migration without digest check.
examples.reason: Path change requires immutable byte identity verification.

examples.scenario: GDAL 3.12 min pixel-function is used instead of last-source priority.
examples.reason: Aggregation semantics changed.

examples.scenario: mean pixel-function is used across overlapping terrain tiles.
examples.reason: A derived average is not a native source elevation.

examples.scenario: SimpleSource points to a different SourceFilename with same basename.
examples.reason: Full source identity must match.

examples.scenario: SourceBand changes from 1 to 2 at an overlap.
examples.reason: Band identity is part of elevation provenance.

examples.scenario: SrcRect shifts one column at a seam.
examples.reason: Different source pixels feed the mosaic.

examples.scenario: DstRect shifts one column while source window stays fixed.
examples.reason: Mosaic placement changes pixel identity.

examples.scenario: Source geotransform differs but VRT XML is unchanged.
examples.reason: SrcRect geospatial meaning changed.

examples.scenario: VRT geotransform changes while DstRect remains constant.
examples.reason: Destination pixel geography changed.

examples.scenario: ComplexSource mask is applied after value scaling in custom code.
examples.reason: GDAL source masking precedes source value transformations.

examples.scenario: Partial alpha is interpreted as weighted blend in a path that only has binary masking.
examples.reason: Binary mask semantics are not fractional blending.

examples.scenario: Mask source file differs while resulting seam values happen to match.
examples.reason: Validity lineage changed despite equal numbers.

examples.scenario: GTI SORT_FIELD is omitted and storage iteration order decides overlap.
examples.reason: Overlap precedence must be deterministic.

examples.scenario: GTI sort direction flips from ascending to descending.
examples.reason: Winner tile may reverse.

examples.scenario: GTI honours alpha while VRT replay ignores it and outputs differ.
examples.reason: Independent paths must implement the same declared policy.

examples.scenario: Mixed-SRS tiles are reprojected on the fly in one mosaic only.
examples.reason: Reprojection can change terrain sampling.

examples.scenario: Misaligned tile origin triggers resampling in GTI.
examples.reason: Resampling affects seam values.

examples.scenario: GTI relative tile path resolves against a moved tile index.
examples.reason: Source location semantics changed.

examples.scenario: Tile footprint in index no longer matches raster geotransform footprint.
examples.reason: Spatial source selection cannot be trusted.

examples.scenario: GTI resolution is inferred from first tile whose ordering changed.
examples.reason: First-tile inference is order dependent.

examples.scenario: GTI datatype is inferred rather than pinned.
examples.reason: Numeric representation must be deterministic.

examples.scenario: Tile index omits nodata although source tiles contain it.
examples.reason: Overlap fallback depends on validity.

examples.scenario: Tile index omits mask metadata for masked tiles.
examples.reason: Compositing validity is incomplete.

examples.scenario: Two overlapping tiles come from different survey dates and winner survey is not recorded.
examples.reason: Target elevation must retain contributing survey provenance.

examples.scenario: A newer survey wins merely because filename sorts later.
examples.reason: Source priority must be deliberate, not accidental lexical order.

examples.scenario: Warp nodata handling differs because kernel changes from nearest to bilinear.
examples.reason: Invalid contributors are handled differently by kernels.

examples.scenario: UNIFIED_SRC_NODATA changes across GDAL versions.
examples.reason: Multi-band validity defaults have changed historically.

examples.scenario: Seam source checksum differs but min/max remain equal.
examples.reason: Equal extrema do not prove immutable source identity.

examples.scenario: Tile bytes differ while metadata matches.
examples.reason: Immutable source bytes are terminal evidence.

examples.scenario: Same file bytes are opened through a different band selection.
examples.reason: Band provenance differs.

examples.scenario: One seam row is duplicated by adjacent tiles and both copies enter extrema.
examples.reason: A logical target cell must appear once after compositing.

examples.scenario: One seam column is omitted due to half-open window mismatch.
examples.reason: Source coverage must be exact and gap-free under the declared mosaic.

examples.scenario: Overlap set count matches but a different cell participates.
examples.reason: Cardinality alone is insufficient.

examples.scenario: Winner-source IDs differ for one equal-valued seam cell.
examples.reason: Equal values do not prove equal provenance.

examples.scenario: Fallback source differs behind a nodata winner but final value matches.
examples.reason: Fallback path belongs in reproducibility evidence.

examples.scenario: Golden mosaic pixels match but CRS differs.
examples.reason: Pixel equality alone cannot prove spatial identity.

examples.scenario: Golden pixels and CRS match but geotransform differs.
examples.reason: Cell geography changed.

examples.scenario: Golden compare finds one seam pixel difference.
examples.reason: Any unexplained seam difference blocks terminal acceptance.

examples.scenario: Primary VRT and independent GTI replay select different winners.
examples.reason: Independent overlap semantics must reconcile.

examples.scenario: GeoTIFF block size changes but logical mosaic pixels are identical.
examples.reason: Storage layout must not redefine logical cell identity.

examples.scenario: Approximate statistics are used to validate a seam window.
examples.reason: Terminal seam replay requires exact pixels.

examples.scenario: Fixture tiles prove overlap logic and their seam values are copied to production.
examples.reason: Examples validate logic only.

examples.scenario: Static mosaic QA passes and target elevation is emitted.
examples.reason: Target contributing tiles are not runtime-bound.

examples.scenario: Canonical point is absent but likely neighboring tiles are guessed.
examples.reason: Target location must drive tile discovery.

examples.scenario: Exact parcel boundary is absent but seam cells are marked target members.
examples.reason: Target membership requires canonical boundary execution.

examples.scenario: Known ACK blocker is relabelled pending.
examples.reason: Known unresolved execution remains BLOCKED; pending stays zero.

examples.scenario: A second mosaic runner is launched for seam replay.
examples.reason: Continuation contract permits only the existing shared runner.

examples.scenario: 99.99 readiness is reported as final terrain or seam accuracy.
examples.reason: Source-chain readiness is not measured target elevation accuracy.
